question_text: Find the equation of the resulting graph $g(x)$ when:

subparts.solution:
The graph of $y = g(x)$ is found by translating $y = f(x)$ 8 units upwards.
$\therefore g(x) = f(x) + 8$
$\therefore g(x) = (x^2 - 5x + 6) + 8$
$\therefore g(x) = x^2 - 5x + 14$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Translating a graph upwards by $k$ units replaces $f(x)$ with $f(x) + k$.
step_by_step: Add 8 to the constant term: $6 + 8 = 14$, giving $g(x) = x^2 - 5x + 14$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Applying the translation to $x$ instead of adding it to the whole function.

subparts.stem: $f(x) = -2x^2 + x + 3$ is translated 1 unit to the right.
subparts.solution:
The graph of $y = g(x)$ is found by translating $y = f(x)$ 1 unit to the right.
$\therefore g(x) = f(x - 1)$
$\therefore g(x) = -2(x - 1)^2 + (x - 1) + 3$
$\therefore g(x) = -2(x^2 - 2x + 1) + x - 1 + 3$
$\therefore g(x) = -2x^2 + 4x - 2 + x + 2$
$\therefore g(x) = -2x^2 + 5x$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Translating a function $h$ units to the right replaces every instance of $x$ with $(x - h)$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Using $(x + 1)$ instead of $(x - 1)$ for a shift to the right.
